1. In Miṣr, let me know. We shall send [it] shortly, so that we may sell that,
  2. lest it spoil. As for the prices, lac is worth
  3. 68(?); cloves, 50(?); nutmeg, a dinar; civet, 8.
  4. The ten strings/beads(?), according to their varieties [...]. As for the
  5. pepper, [...] its price, because [...] has not arrived. [...] The silver
  6. coin/silver is [worth] from 8 to 8 less a qīrāṭ.
  7. The Aleppan met me at Raʾs Tīnī on the day of [his] return(?),
  8. and handed me a letter for [...]
  9. I was informed that he had moved on(?) and had already weighed it(?).
  10. This [sum/item], therefore, you should hand over to [...] [...] and [...]
  11. [...] altogether, safely; and that he is in Abū [Ṣīr?].
  12. [At] Raʾs Tīnī, and with them was a Byzantine ship.
  13. [...] them. A Byzantine ship arrived from [...]
  14. and aboard it were Jews from al-Mahdiyya, and Ibn Nufayʿ [...]
  15. b. Nahray, and they reported that the ship [...]
